config.note: vLLM is not installed, so rollouts use ms-swift's TransformersEngine
config.algorithm_note: This run is plain GRPO, not GSPO. GSPO in ms-swift is GRPO with --importance_sampling_level sequence, a separate flag in the same args class; an earlier revision of this record wrongly claimed GSPO was unavailable because the rlhf_type choices exclude the name gspo.
config.seed_source: Reconstructed, not logged: the launcher passed a literal --seed 3407 (projects/wafer-defect-vlm/scripts/24_train_grpo.sh, line 115 at commit b1092dc, the last commit in which the flag was still a literal) and no launcher set a seed any other way, so every run through that script used 3407. Written here so a later replication run can be shown to differ from its original rather than merely asserted to.
config.importance_sampling_level_source: Reconstructed, not logged: the record was written before the launcher forwarded this setting into its config block. Read from the run's own log (24_grpo_qwen35_9b_grpo_v1.log), which states it once: token. Recorded because a GRPO record with no IS level cannot be distinguished from a GSPO one -- GSPO is GRPO at --importance_sampling_level sequence in this ms-swift commit -- and the GRPO-vs-GSPO comparison depends on that distinction.

log_note: Repointed from logs/29_<tag>_train.log, which the launcher shares between runs: the first GSPO run reused the tag `grpo` and overwrote it, so that file no longer contains this run's output. This per-run inner log is the artefact the numbers come from.
frac_reward_zero_std_note: Share of logged optimizer steps where every generation in the group scored identically, so the advantage was zero and no gradient was produced. Recomputed from the per-run log, not copied from prose.
